episodes.continuity: Begins directly after S01E12: Lin Qian is still in the blue-black evidence corridor beside the sealed medical cooler. The empty plasma position becomes a private warning, then a new blood-loss case arrives. Lin Qian follows procedure and does not cover for Jian Ci.

clips.title: 少了一袋
clips.scene: Blue-black evidence corridor from S01E12. Lin Qian inspects the sealed medical cooler and notices one empty plasma slot; a distant emergency corridor light begins to pulse.
shots: 0.00-1.66 Lin Qian checks the sealed cooler beside the same steel trolley
1.66-3.33 close evidence view of one empty, unmarked plasma slot
3.33-5.00 Lin Qian turns toward a distant emergency light in the corridor

clips.title: 没有大伤口
clips.scene: Forensic intake bay. A young delivery rider lies fully clothed and still on a covered gurney; helmet and insulated delivery bag are sealed separately. Jian Ci and Lin Qian observe without touching unlogged evidence.
shots: 0.00-1.66 covered gurney, helmet and insulated delivery bag under cold intake light
1.66-3.33 Jian Ci observes the rider's pale hand without touching it
3.33-5.00 Lin Qian photographs the intact clothing and sealed bag

dialogue.speaker: 剑刺
dialogue.zh: 没有大伤口，血却少得太多。
dialogue.en: There is no major wound, yet far too much blood is gone.

clips.title: 胶布下面
clips.scene: Forensic examination room. Xu Wei leads a safety-safe examination of a small medical adhesive square already placed on a neutral stainless-steel evidence tray. Lin Qian stays at the clean boundary and documents.
shots: 0.00-1.66 Xu Wei photographs a small medical adhesive square resting on a neutral stainless-steel evidence tray; no person or body is visible
1.66-3.33 gloved tweezers lift one corner above the tray, revealing only a faint circular impression in the adhesive material
3.33-5.00 Xu Wei seals the adhesive in a clear evidence bag while Lin Qian records the evidence number without visible text

dialogue.speaker: 许未
dialogue.zh: 不是新痕，是被胶布遮住的旧痕。
dialogue.en: They are not fresh marks. The adhesive had concealed an older trace.

clips.safety_override: The locked storyboard is a non-authoritative composition reference for cast and lighting only. Do not reproduce any exposed arm, skin, body, injury, puncture, needle, wound, blood, medical fluid or close-up anatomy from it. Render only the sealed adhesive evidence on the tray.

clips.title: 许未的结论
clips.scene: Forensic laboratory. Xu Wei independently compares sealed sample tubes and a simple physical evidence chain. Jian Ci and Lin Qian listen; Xu Wei controls the workstation.
shots: 0.00-1.66 Xu Wei studies separated clear sample tubes under blue lab light
1.66-3.33 she traces an unlabeled evidence chain between repeated draws and abnormal clotting
3.33-5.00 Jian Ci and Lin Qian listen while Xu Wei remains at the center of the frame

dialogue.speaker: 许未
dialogue.zh: 结果异常，但还不能单独解释死因。
dialogue.en: The findings are abnormal, but they cannot explain the cause of death alone.

clips.title: 反复预约
clips.scene: Digital-forensics room. Zhou Qiao reconstructs physical appointment cards and route times with colored pins, no readable interface. Lin Qian sees the pattern emerging.
shots: 0.00-1.66 Zhou Qiao aligns repeated appointment cards on a physical board
1.66-3.33 a simple pin-and-thread pattern marks increasingly short intervals
3.33-5.00 Lin Qian studies the pattern as Zhou Qiao points to the final appointment

dialogue.speaker: 周峤
dialogue.zh: 这些预约，不像一次体检。
dialogue.en: These appointments do not look like a single health check.

clips.title: 补贴不是同意
clips.scene: Rain-muted community clinic waiting room. Lin Qian observes a recruiter giving a small meal voucher to a tired low-income courier; no accusation, no readable paperwork, only the power imbalance.
shots: 0.00-1.66 a tired courier sits beneath dim clinic light, holding an unmarked meal voucher
1.66-3.33 a recruiter slides an unreadable form across a plain desk
3.33-5.00 Lin Qian watches through the glass, controlled and concerned

dialogue.speaker: 林浅
dialogue.zh: 拿补贴，不等于同意被反复抽血。
dialogue.en: Taking a subsidy does not mean agreeing to repeated blood draws.

clips.title: 身体先说话
clips.scene: Forensic briefing bench. Xu Wei lays separate sealed evidence groups in order: concealed punctures, appointment intervals and abnormal results. Jian Ci maintains distance from the samples and listens.
shots: 0.00-1.66 Xu Wei places three sealed evidence groups apart on a clean bench
1.66-3.33 close on the simple physical sequence connecting them
3.33-5.00 Jian Ci listens from the clean boundary while Xu Wei closes the final seal

dialogue.speaker: 许未
dialogue.zh: 反复抽血，身体会先给答案。
dialogue.en: With repeated blood draws, the body gives the answer first.

clips.title: 被改过的合格
clips.scene: Records room. Lin Qian and Zhou Qiao compare an original sealed lab printout against a later altered record, using matching page edges and physical timestamps; all writing remains unreadable.
shots: 0.00-1.66 Lin Qian opens two sealed record sleeves on separate evidence mats
1.66-3.33 Zhou Qiao compares their physical timestamps and page edges
3.33-5.00 Lin Qian photographs the mismatch as rain reflects across the shelves

dialogue.speaker: 周峤
dialogue.en: The passing result was added later.

clips.title: 冷库边界
clips.scene: Medical-waste cold room. Expired plasma bags await disposal behind a steel rack. Jian Ci stops at the doorway, visibly strained but not touching anything; Xu Wei completes a routine evidence check outside the room.
shots: 0.00-1.66 rows of sealed expired plasma bags glow dimly in the cold room
1.66-3.33 Jian Ci pauses at the steel doorway, hand tense but held back
3.33-5.00 Xu Wei seals a routine disposal record outside while Jian Ci remains alone at the boundary

dialogue.speaker: 剑刺
dialogue.en: This blood was meant to be destroyed.

clips.title: 越过规则
clips.scene: Same cold room, now empty. Jian Ci is alone and tears open one expired bag from the disposal rack. His red eyes flicker and faint fangs show for an instant; he harms no person and does not use any power.
shots: 0.00-1.66 Jian Ci reaches for one expired bag only after checking the empty room
1.66-3.33 his control breaks: the bag opens, with no gore and no person present
3.33-5.00 he lowers it in shame as his red reflection fades from the steel door

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.zh: 这一次，他越过了自己的规则。
dialogue.en: This time, he crossed his own rule.

clips.title: 林浅记录
clips.scene: Cold-room doorway. Lin Qian enters and sees the opened expired bag. Jian Ci immediately sets it down and steps back. Lin Qian photographs and seals the scene; she neither covers it up nor calls him a monster.
shots: 0.00-1.66 Lin Qian stops at the doorway; Jian Ci sets the opened bag down
1.66-3.33 Jian Ci steps back behind the steel threshold with his eyes normal again
3.33-5.00 Lin Qian photographs the bag and seals it as evidence, calm but shaken

dialogue.speaker: 林浅
dialogue.en: Put it down. I will document it.

clips.title: 雨里的车
clips.scene: Evidence corridor to rain-dark exterior. Lin Qian seals the altered-record evidence while Zhou Qiao tracks the delivery rider's last transport route. An unmarked van leaves through rain, creating the next lead rather than resolving the case.
shots: 0.00-1.66 Lin Qian seals the altered-record evidence bag on a steel table
1.66-3.33 Zhou Qiao pins the last transport route to a physical map, no readable labels
3.33-5.00 an unmarked van drives into rain as Lin Qian watches from the corridor window

dialogue.speaker: 林浅
dialogue.zh: 先查这辆车，再查这间机构。
dialogue.en: We trace this van first, then the organization.
